title: nan
authors: Hakonen-Milosevic K.; Milosevic Z.; Aaltonen J.; Koskinen K.T.
key_contribution: Presents a context-sensitive Guidance, Navigation and Control framework for autonomous vehicles in GNSS-denied underground mines, integrating SLAM, map fusion, and odometry with fleet coordination.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
